# Identifying Blackout Locations During the 2021 Texas Power Crisis

## Load Data
```{r}
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap) # map making
library(kableExtra) # table formatting
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(here)
```

```{r}
lights_7_1 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif')
lights_7_2 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
lights_16_1 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
lights_16_2 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')

roads <- st_read(here('data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg'), query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'")

houses <- st_read(here('data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg'), query = "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type IN ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')")
```

## Data Merging

```{r}
lights_7 <- merge(lights_7_1, lights_7_2)
lights_16 <- merge(lights_16_1, lights_16_2)
```

## Create Blackout Mask

```{r}
# calculate differences in light
light_dif <- lights_16 - lights_7

# reclassify to under 200
rcl <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 200, NA,
    200, Inf, 1
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

reclassified <- classify(light_dif, rcl = rcl)

# vectorize raster
reclassified_vect <- st_as_stars(reclassified) |> st_as_sf()
```


```{r}
# create a raster with a smaller extent
# Create the bbox extent of Houston
clip <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
  crs = st_crs(reclassified_vect)
)

# select values that fall within smaller extent
lights_clip <- st_crop(reclassified_vect, clip)

# verify that output has fewer values than original
if(ncell(reclassified_vect) == nrow(lights_clip)) {
  warning("clipping did not remove cells")
} else {
  print("clipping removed cells")
}

lights_clip <- st_transform(lights_clip, crs = 3083)
```

mapping lights before and after

```{r}
# ISSUE: NO POINTS IN LIGHTS_7??
lights_7[lights_7 > 1000] <- NA

tm_shape(lights_7) +
    tm_raster(col_alpha = 0.7, col.scale = tm_scale(values = "inferno")) 
    #tm_basemap('OpenStreetMap')
```


## Exclude Highways

```{r}
# make roads crs the same as lights
roads <- st_transform(roads, crs = 3083)

# 200m buffer around highways
buffer <- st_union(st_buffer(roads, dist = 200))

lights_buff <- st_difference(lights_clip, buffer)

tm_shape(lights_buff) +
    tm_polygons()

```
